title: Setting up a basic Python application

cues.en: So, we have our development environment all set up, and it's time to start writing some code.
cues.zh: 開發環境都準備好了，現在可以開始寫程式。

cues.en: And my goal this time around, in this section, is just to write a Python application that connects to an LLM and allows us to have a chat.
cues.zh: 這一節的目標，是寫一個能連接 LLM 並讓我們聊天的 Python 應用程式。

cues.en: And I want to be using the OpenAI Software Development Kit, the library that allows us to connect to any OpenAI compatible LLM, and that includes Olama, which I'll be using in this course.
cues.zh: 我要使用 OpenAI 軟體開發套件，也就是能連接任何相容 OpenAI 的 LLM 的函式庫，包括這門課使用的 Ollama。

cues.en: But it also includes ChatGPT, and Mistral, and Grok, and lots of others, okay?
cues.zh: 當然也包括 ChatGPT、Mistral、Grok 等許多服務。

cues.en: So you can use whichever LLM you want to.
cues.zh: 所以你可以使用任何想用的 LLM。

cues.en: If you want to, you can just go to ChatGPT, create an account, fund it with $5 or some small amount of money, which is more than enough for this course, and just connect directly
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以到 ChatGPT 建立帳號，儲值 5 美元或其他小額款項；這些金額已足夠完成課程，然後直接連接

cues.en: to ChatGPT servers.
cues.zh: ChatGPT 的伺服器。

cues.en: It's entirely up to you.
cues.zh: 完全由你決定。

cues.en: But I'm going to use Olama.
cues.zh: 不過我會使用 Ollama。

cues.en: So right now I have Visual Studio Code open, but I haven't opened a folder.
cues.zh: 目前我已開啟 Visual Studio Code，但還沒有開啟任何資料夾。

cues.en: So I'm going to open a folder I created on my desktop over here, and it's called Pyrag, okay?
cues.zh: 我要開啟桌面上先前建立的資料夾，叫做 pyrag。

cues.en: And there's nothing in there.
cues.zh: 裡面目前是空的。

cues.en: So I'll open that.
cues.zh: 把它開啟。

cues.en: And of course, the very first thing I want to do is to set up my Python virtual environment.
cues.zh: 當然，第一件事是設定 Python 虛擬環境。

cues.en: So I'll open my terminal, and the first thing I'll do is say pyonv local 3.12.9, that one we downloaded, okay? So there.
cues.zh: 開啟終端機，先輸入 pyenv local 3.12.9，就是之前下載的版本。

cues.en: And that, of course, created the .python-version file, which is simply a text file that's says what version of Python we're using. Perfect.
cues.zh: 這會產生 .python-version 檔案；它只是個文字檔，用來記錄使用的 Python 版本。很好。

cues.en: Now, I'll clear the screen.
cues.zh: 接著清除畫面。

cues.en: So I'll type python-m, and I want to create a virtual environment, venv, and I want to store it in .venv, okay?
cues.zh: 輸入 python -m，使用 venv 建立虛擬環境，並將它存到 .venv。

cues.en: And that should do it for me. And it does.
cues.zh: 這樣應該就完成了，確實如此。

cues.en: Now, of course, I want to activate it.
cues.zh: 接著當然要啟用它。

cues.en: So source.venv bin activate.
cues.zh: 輸入 source .venv/bin/activate。

cues.en: And if you're on Windows, you'll use the one appropriate for your environment.
cues.zh: 如果使用 Windows，就用適合自己環境的指令。

cues.en: So now I'm in my virtual environment. Perfect.
cues.zh: 現在已經進入虛擬環境，很好。

cues.en: Now, let's get started.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: So the first thing I'll do is come over here and create a directory, a new directory, a new folder called src, and that's where our source code will live.
cues.zh: 首先在這裡建立一個新目錄，也就是新資料夾 src，之後原始碼都放在這裡。

cues.en: And inside of that, I'll create another directory inside src called pyreg, okay?
cues.zh: 再在 src 裡面建立一個叫做 pyrag 的目錄。

cues.en: We want to keep things as clean as we possibly can, and ultimately, we'll be able to use this project and import it to any Python project that needs a reg application, okay?
cues.zh: 我們希望結構盡量乾淨，最終也能將這個專案匯入任何需要 RAG 應用程式的 Python 專案。

cues.en: So that's created.
cues.zh: 目錄建立好了。

cues.en: Now, of course, we want something inside of there, and we'll do what you do in lots of Python projects.
cues.zh: 接著當然要在裡面放些東西，就像許多 Python 專案的慣例一樣。

cues.en: We'll create that magic file, __init__.py.
cues.zh: 建立那個特殊檔案 __init__.py。

cues.en: So I'll create a new file named __init__.py for Python.
cues.zh: 所以新增一個 Python 檔，命名為 __init__.py。

cues.en: And in here, I'm just going to put one thing for right now, okay?
cues.zh: 目前裡面只放一個設定。

cues.en: __version__ equals, and then in quotes, 0.1.0.
cues.zh: __version__ 等於字串 "0.1.0"。

cues.en: And that's enough for right now.
cues.zh: 現在這樣就夠了。

cues.en: We'll be coming back to this later on, okay?
cues.zh: 之後還會回來修改。

cues.en: So this is the, what's called in the Python world, the L2 starting point, and just enough to stream chat from any OpenAI compatible API, okay?
cues.zh: 這是 Python 專案最小可用的起點，先做到能透過任何相容 OpenAI 的 API 串流聊天就好。

cues.en: Everything like ingestion and retrieval and storage, that's going to come later on.
cues.zh: 像是資料匯入、檢索與儲存，之後才會加上。

cues.en: We just want to get this working right now.
cues.zh: 現在只要先讓它能運作。

cues.en: So I've created that.
cues.zh: 這個檔案已建立。

cues.en: Now, the next thing I want is at the root level of my projects, we'll just come down below all of these files, right click, and choose new file.
cues.zh: 接著回到專案根目錄，在這些檔案下面按右鍵，選擇新增檔案。

cues.en: And this is going to be called pyproject.toml.
cues.zh: 這個檔案叫做 pyproject.toml。

cues.en: Of course, this describes our project.
cues.zh: 它用來描述專案，

cues.en: What's our build system?
cues.zh: 例如使用哪個建置系統、

cues.en: What's the name of the project?
cues.zh: 專案名稱是什麼，

cues.en: Things like that.
cues.zh: 以及這類資訊。

cues.en: And this is going to be very short for right now, but once again, we'll be coming back to it later on.
cues.zh: 目前內容會很精簡，但之後還會回來修改。

cues.en: So the first entry is in square brackets, and it's a block, okay?
cues.zh: 第一項用方括號括起來，是一個設定區塊。

cues.en: And it's called build-system, okay?
cues.zh: 名稱叫做 build-system。

cues.en: We have to have that.
cues.zh: 這個區塊是必要的。

cues.en: And what are the requirements for our build system?
cues.zh: 建置系統需要哪些套件？

cues.en: Well, requires, which I have to spell right, equals in square brackets and in quotes, something called hatchling, okay?
cues.zh: requires，注意拼字，等於方括號中的字串 "hatchling"。

cues.en: And this is a build system, the one that in fact is recommended by the Python package manager group for building command line interface applications, CLIs, and that's exactly what we're doing.
cues.zh: 它是一種建置系統，也是 Python 套件管理相關組織推薦用來建置命令列介面應用程式，也就是 CLI 的工具；我們做的正是這類應用。

cues.en: And then we have to specify what's the build backend, okay?
cues.zh: 接著要指定建置後端。

cues.en: And that's going to be, this time no square brackets, hatchling.build, okay?
cues.zh: 這次不加方括號，值設為 "hatchling.build"。

cues.en: So that's the first block.
cues.zh: 這就是第一個區塊。

cues.en: The second block just describes the project, and it's called project in square brackets.
cues.zh: 第二個區塊描述專案本身，名稱是方括號中的 project。

cues.en: And it has to have a name.
cues.zh: 它必須有名稱。

cues.en: Well, I'll call mine pyreq.
cues.zh: 我把它叫做 pyrag。

cues.en: That seems simple enough, okay?
cues.zh: 這樣很簡單。

cues.en: And it also has to have a version, and I'll make that equal to 0.1.0, which is the conventional starting point for this sort of thing, okay?
cues.zh: 也必須有版本，我設為 0.1.0，這是這類專案慣用的起始版本。

cues.en: And then a description, which can be anything I want, but I'll just say local rag with directory
cues.zh: 接著是 description，可以填任何想寫的內容，我就寫本機 RAG、目錄

cues.en: watched ingestion, which is not true, but will be by the time we're done, and a swappable vector store.
cues.zh: 監看式資料匯入，以及可替換的向量儲存區。現在還沒做到，但課程結束時就會實現。

cues.en: And of course, we're going to begin with Postgres.
cues.zh: 一開始會使用 Postgres，

cues.en: That will be our vector store, but later on, we'll switch it to Weaviate just to see how you can use different vector stores, okay?
cues.zh: 作為向量儲存區；之後再換成 Weaviate，示範如何使用不同的向量儲存區。

cues.en: And what version of Python does it require?
cues.zh: 那麼，需要哪個版本的 Python？

cues.en: Well, requires-python, that's going to be equal to, greater than or equal to, say, 3.11, which will absolutely work.
cues.zh: requires-python 設為大於等於 3.11，這個版本一定能用。

cues.en: We're using 3.12, but it's going to be 3.11.
cues.zh: 我們用的是 3.12，但需求設為 3.11。

cues.en: And just a note, if, like me, you have rough installed, you're probably getting little error messages, little dialogues in the lower right-hand corner.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，如果你跟我一樣裝了 Ruff，右下角可能會一直跳出小型錯誤提示。

cues.en: Just ignore those.
cues.zh: 先忽略它們。

cues.en: They'll go away, and they don't matter right now, okay?
cues.zh: 稍後就會消失，目前不影響操作。

cues.en: Now our project is also going to have dependencies, and we'll start with just a few.
cues.zh: 專案還需要相依套件，我們先加入幾個。

cues.en: Dependencies, okay?
cues.zh: 設定 dependencies，

cues.en: That's going to be equal to, in square brackets, and I'll put them on multiple lines, we're going to use something called typer, okay?
cues.zh: 等於一個串列，用方括號括起來，我會分成多行。首先使用 typer。

cues.en: And that has to be greater than or equal to 0.12, okay?
cues.zh: 版本必須大於等於 0.12。

cues.en: So we have to have that.
cues.zh: 所以需要這一項。

cues.en: And then we're also going to have Python, which I have to spell right, dash dot on.
cues.zh: 接著還需要 python-dotenv，注意拼字。

cues.en: We're going to read our environment variables from a dot on file, and that has to be greater than or equal to, say, 1.0, okay?
cues.zh: 我們會從 .env 檔案讀取環境變數，版本需求設為大於等於 1.0。

cues.en: And then a comma.
cues.zh: 接著加上逗號。

cues.en: And the third one for now is our OpenAI client, OpenAI greater than or equal to 1.50, and then a comma.
cues.zh: 目前第三個是 OpenAI 用戶端：openai 大於等於 1.50，後面也加逗號。

cues.en: So that's our second block.
cues.zh: 這就是第二個區塊。

cues.en: And, of course, we're going to be adding more dependencies as time goes on, but this is enough.
cues.zh: 之後當然會繼續加入更多相依套件，但目前這樣就夠了。

cues.en: These three are enough, plus this build back end, to allow us to have a command line application, okay?
cues.zh: 這三個套件，加上建置後端，就足以讓我們建立命令列應用程式。

cues.en: Now, we're also going to have scripts, and the scripts will allow me to do things like run Pyrag, the name of my application, chat, or something like that, okay?
cues.zh: 專案也會定義 scripts，讓我能執行像 pyrag chat 這樣的命令；pyrag 就是應用程式名稱。

cues.en: So I'm going to have a block called project dot scripts, okay?
cues.zh: 因此加入 project.scripts 區塊。

cues.en: And that has one entry, Pyrag equals, and for right now, we're just going to go with Pyrag dot CLI colon app, okay?
cues.zh: 目前只有一項：pyrag 等於 "pyrag.cli:app"。

cues.en: That will change later on, but this is enough to get us started, okay?
cues.zh: 之後會修改，但現在已足以開始。

cues.en: That'll allow me to have my Pyrag command.
cues.zh: 這樣就能使用 pyrag 指令。

cues.en: And then down here, we're going to have one specific to the build scripts, and this is
cues.zh: 接著下面還有建置腳本專用的設定，

cues.en: a hatchling specific thing, tool dot hatch dot build dot target dot wheel, okay?
cues.zh: 這是 Hatchling 專用的部分：tool.hatch.build.target.wheel。

cues.en: And that has one entry.
cues.zh: 裡面只有一項，

cues.en: Where is the source code?
cues.zh: 用來指定原始碼的位置。

cues.en: Packages equals, in square brackets, and in our case, it's in the source directory, and the files we're going to be working on shortly will be in the Pyrag directory.
cues.zh: packages 等於方括號中的路徑。我們的原始碼在 src 目錄，而接下來要處理的檔案位於 pyrag 目錄。

cues.en: So that gives me my pyproject dot toml, and as I said, we'll be coming back to this quite frequently actually to add things to it and to change things, but that's enough to get us started.
cues.zh: 這樣就完成 pyproject.toml。之後會經常回來新增與修改設定，不過目前已足以開始。

cues.en: Now, the next thing I want is to create three files, and they're all going to be inside the Pyrag directory, so let's create three empty files just to get started, okay?
cues.zh: 接著要建立三個檔案，全部放在 pyrag 目錄。先建立三個空白檔案。

cues.en: A new file, the first one will be called cli dot py, okay?
cues.zh: 第一個新檔案叫做 cli.py。

cues.en: And then we'll create another one also in the Pyrag directory, a new file, and this one will be called config dot py.
cues.zh: 再在 pyrag 目錄新增一個 config.py。

cues.en: And then we'll create a third one, a new file, called llm dot py, okay?
cues.zh: 第三個新檔案叫做 llm.py。

cues.en: So let's get started with these, and I'm going to do this in a bottom-up order so we don't have too many missing dependencies as we're writing code, okay?
cues.zh: 接下來會採由下而上的順序，避免寫程式時出現太多尚未建立的相依項目。

cues.en: I'm going to start with config dot py, our configuration file.
cues.zh: 先從設定檔 config.py 開始。

cues.en: Let's hide the terminal.
cues.zh: 先把終端機隱藏。

cues.en: Now, let's start with our imports, okay?
cues.zh: 我們從匯入項目開始。

cues.en: So I'm going to use annotations, and that exists in the future package, so from underscore underscore future, okay?
cues.zh: 我要使用 annotations，它位於 __future__ 套件，所以寫 from __future__，

cues.en: We're going to import annotations right there.
cues.zh: 再匯入 annotations。

cues.en: We'll be using that.
cues.zh: 之後會用到，

cues.en: They're very helpful.
cues.zh: 很方便。

cues.en: We're also going to have to be able to read from the file system, so import os, the operating system, okay?
cues.zh: 也需要讀取檔案系統，所以 import os，也就是作業系統模組。

cues.en: And then from dataclasses, which is part of the standard library, we'll import dataclass right there.
cues.zh: 接著從標準函式庫的 dataclasses 匯入 dataclass。

cues.en: And the last one we'll want is from dot onv.
cues.zh: 最後還需要從 dotenv，

cues.en: We're going to import load dot onv, and that didn't do the autocomplete for me, and that's
cues.zh: 匯入 load_dotenv。不過它沒有自動完成，

cues.en: because — let's reopen our terminal — I need to run pip install dash e dot, and that
cues.zh: 那是因為——先重新開啟終端機——我得先執行 pip install -e .，

cues.en: should bring all my dependencies in, which I should have done before I started writing code, but there you go.
cues.zh: 把所有相依套件裝進來。我應該在開始寫程式前就做，不過現在補上。

cues.en: So it's working away, and everything is now up to date. Perfect. Okay.
cues.zh: 安裝正在進行，現在所有套件都已更新完成。很好。

cues.en: So we have our imports done.
cues.zh: 匯入項目已經處理好了。

cues.en: Now, what are we going to do in here?
cues.zh: 接著在這裡要做什麼？

cues.en: Let's define a few functions.
cues.zh: 先定義幾個函式。

cues.en: Let's define def — I should have another blank line there — def, one called underscore env, okay?
cues.zh: 寫 def；這裡應該再加一個空白行。函式名稱是 _env。

cues.en: And this is simply a helper function, okay?
cues.zh: 這只是個輔助函式。

cues.en: And we'll have a key, and I'll type in that to string, and default, which I'll type into string as well.
cues.zh: 它接收 key，型別標註為 str，以及 default，也標註為 str。

cues.en: We'll use this to read from the dot onv file.
cues.zh: 我們用它讀取 .env 檔案中的設定。

cues.en: And it's going to return a string.
cues.zh: 回傳值是一個字串。

cues.en: Very simple function, okay?
cues.zh: 函式非常簡單。

cues.en: Val equals os dot get onv, right from the standard library.
cues.zh: val 等於標準函式庫中的 os.getenv。

cues.en: We're going to read a value from the environment.
cues.zh: 我們要從環境讀取一個值，

cues.en: We're going to read key, okay?
cues.zh: 也就是讀取 key 對應的值。

cues.en: And then we'll return val.
cues.zh: 然後回傳 val，

cues.en: But if val is not none, and val is not equal to an empty string, else return default, okay?
cues.zh: 條件是 val 不是 None，也不是空字串；否則回傳 default。

cues.en: So in this case, we can call this function, give it a key that should exist in the environment with a default if it does not.
cues.zh: 所以呼叫這個函式時，傳入預期存在於環境中的 key，以及找不到時要使用的預設值。

cues.en: If the key exists, we return its value.
cues.zh: 如果 key 存在，就回傳它的值。

cues.en: If it doesn't, we return whatever's stored in default.
cues.zh: 如果不存在，就回傳 default 裡的內容。

cues.en: Very simple function, okay?
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: So we have that.
cues.zh: 這部分完成了。

cues.en: Now the next one is going to be our config, and here's where I'm going to use that annotation data class, okay?
cues.zh: 下一個是 Config，這裡會使用 dataclass 裝飾器，

cues.en: The one we just added to our imports.
cues.zh: 就是剛才匯入的那個。

cues.en: And we'll say frozen, which has to spell right, frozen equals true, okay?
cues.zh: 設定 frozen，注意拼字，frozen=True。

cues.en: And this is a class.
cues.zh: 這是一個類別。

cues.en: Class, and we'll call it config, okay?
cues.zh: 寫 class，命名為 Config。

cues.en: And in here, we just have three entries, okay?
cues.zh: 裡面只有三個欄位，

cues.en: Very simple ones.
cues.zh: 都很簡單。

cues.en: First of all, we're going to need open AI underscore base underscore URL, okay?
cues.zh: 首先需要 openai_base_url。

cues.en: And that's a string, and then we'll put or none, like that, okay?
cues.zh: 它的型別是 str 或 None。

cues.en: And all that is, is the default URL for talking to our LLM, and in our case, that'll be localhost if we're using a llama.
cues.zh: 這個值是與 LLM 溝通的預設 URL。如果使用 Ollama，我們的情況會是 localhost。

cues.en: But if you're using a chat GPT, it'll be a different URL, okay?
cues.zh: 如果使用 ChatGPT，則會是不同的 URL。

cues.en: We're also going to need an API key, open AI underscore API underscore key, and that will be a string, okay?
cues.zh: 我們還需要 API 金鑰 openai_api_key，型別是 str。

cues.en: Now you might be saying to yourself, well, I'm using a llama, I don't need an API key.
cues.zh: 你可能會想：我用 Ollama，根本不需要 API 金鑰。

cues.en: No, you don't to connect to a llama locally, but the library we're using, the open AI SDK,
cues.zh: 沒錯，本機連接 Ollama 不需要。但我們使用的函式庫，也就是 OpenAI SDK，

cues.en: that one does require some values, anything at all for an open AI key, okay?
cues.zh: 要求 openai_api_key 必須有個值，任何值都可以。

cues.en: And then chat underscore model.
cues.zh: 接著是 chat_model，
